title: Bear cub eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- bear body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='28' ry='24' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='17' ry='16' fill='#e8a95c'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='22' fill='#c47222'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='20' r='10' fill='#c47222'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='20' r='10' fill='#c47222'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='20' r='5.5' fill='#f0b878'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='20' r='5.5' fill='#f0b878'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='12' ry='9' fill='#f0c090'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='34' r='3.5' fill='#3a1a00'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='34' r='3.5' fill='#3a1a00'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='33' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='33' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='43' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#3a1a00'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M46 48 Q50 52 54 48' stroke='#3a1a00' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='44' r='4' fill='#e88a5a' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='44' r='4' fill='#e88a5a' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- arms holding snack -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='64' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#b5651d' transform='rotate(-20 34 64)'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='64' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#b5651d' transform='rotate(20 66 64)'/>
  <!-- snack (honey cookie) -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='62' r='7' fill='#e8b830'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='62' r='5' fill='#f5d060'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='60' r='1' fill='#c49010'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='63' r='1' fill='#c49010'/>
  <circle cx='49' cy='64' r='0.8' fill='#c49010'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='93' rx='10' ry='7' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='93' rx='10' ry='7' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='92' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#e8a95c'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='92' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#e8a95c'/>
</svg>
